from PIL import Image; import numpy as np
im=np.asarray(Image.open('observations/obs_0164.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
mid=(abs(R-76)<12)&(abs(G-80)<12)&(abs(B-86)<12)   # top-face neutral
blk=(R<40)&(G<45)&(B<45)                            # near black
def runs(col):
    idx=np.where(col)[0]
    if len(idx)==0: return None
    g=[];s=idx[0];p=idx[0]
    for i in idx[1:]:
        if i!=p+1: g.append((int(s),int(p))); s=i
        p=i
    g.append((int(s),int(p))); return g
for u in range(344,512,8):
    print('u',u,'mid',runs(mid[:,u]),'blk',runs(blk[:,u]))
" 2>/dev/null
